item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus las sgra khrid snod bcud rig pa'i sgra dbyangs
item.coloph: ces sgra khrid snod bcud rig pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i kho bo rigs (rig) 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po rtsal gyis gnas chen pad ma brtsegs pa'i nye 'dabs/ dar rgyas g.yung drung gling du rtsom (brtsams) pa dge legs 'phel bar shog/
